metadata.description: Claude Code mods: agent gate, bash tidy, headroom HUD, laya router, STE100, verify gate.

plugins.name: agent-gate
plugins.description: Puts every Agent (subagent) call to the permission decider instead of running it unasked.

plugins.name: bash-tidy
plugins.description: Drops redundant cd from Bash commands and asks before cat/grep/sed -i that Read, Grep or Edit would do.

plugins.name: headroom-hud
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: context-window gauge, session cost and headroom proxy savings.

plugins.name: laya-router
plugins.description: Rates each prompt with a local laya-serve and adds one advisory line naming a model tier.

plugins.name: ste100
plugins.description: Asks the model to write in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English and lints each answer against its sentence rules.

plugins.name: verify-gate
plugins.description: Asks before git commit or gh pr create while edited code has not passed a check command since its last edit.
